title: Will not fit a rectangular shower frame
text:
Will not fit a rectangular shower frame. I knew they would be a “might” fit and perhaps I could bend them to my needs but I’ll just leave at a charity shop. Someone might be able to use them. They don’t have enough “give” like I hoped. Cheap they are and cheap they look, but I would have kept them if they fit. I’m that desperate! I just need them for a temporary measure as I await for the next six months to have my entire bath redone. I guess I’ll get round ones.
The only other rectangular ones I found (and might not fit) were about $20+ EACH and were made for a nice curtain rod.
